facts.fact: The museum was inaugurated in 1888 as the Aloui Museum and later renamed the Bardo National Museum.
facts.excerpt: The Bardo Museum was first formally inaugurated on 7 May 1888
facts.location: Public page main heritage description; manually read November 1, 2026

facts.fact: Its historic building is a nineteenth-century royal palace with Mediterranean decorative influences, and collections cover prehistory through modern times.
facts.excerpt: It is a 19th  century Bey (royal) palace which reflects a decoration combining various influences of the Mediterranean cultures of the time: Andalusian-Moorish, Ottoman, with a prominent Italian influence.
facts.location: Public page main heritage description; manually read November 1, 2026

facts.fact: Mosaics cover mythology, beliefs, seasons and daily life including fishing, maritime trade and rural estates; sculpture and Islamic collections are also described.
facts.excerpt: Daily life holds a special place on these mosaics, marine life: fishing, maritime trade, a boat catalogue, rural life: large estates, pleasure villas, wild game hunting, sports and leisure activities, etc.).
